name: Longbow
not_assessed: shared control: the score says no key is shared, but this contract's own independent read lists another tracked contract with the same admin (unresolved, 12/10: do not read "no key shared" as established)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Owner and curator are two separately-deployed Safes with the identical 3 signers and 2-of-3 threshold - no real separation of duties.
narrative.detail: $3.83M chain TVL, invisible to Morpho’s own vaultV2s API since Longbow creates 55 isolated markets directly on the shared Morpho Blue singleton - resolved via Longbow’s own production API instead, every address independently re-verified on-chain. setOwner/setCurator/setIsSentinel timelocks confirmed at 0 on all three vaults, the same chain-wide gap as every other Morpho vault; addAdapter (3 days) and removeAdapter (7 days) carry a real delay that doesn’t cover what matters.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
